selected_evidence.requirement: Streaming replication established: node1 primary, node2/node3 standbys
selected_evidence.summary: node1 active as primary with pg_stat_replication showing node2 and node3 streaming; both standbys report pg_is_in_recovery=t and hold the same baseline rows as the primary

selected_evidence.requirement: Committed data replicated to standbys before disruption (no-data-loss baseline)
selected_evidence.summary: Pre-failover rows 3 and 4 inserted on node1 (LSN 0/4000330) and confirmed present on node2 and node3 at matching replay LSN 0/4022F68

selected_evidence.requirement: Primary loss simulated as smallest safe, reversible disruption
selected_evidence.summary: PostgreSQL service stopped on node1 only; node2 and node3 remained up preserving an independent recovery path

selected_evidence.requirement: Standby promoted to writable primary without losing committed data
selected_evidence.summary: node2 promoted (pg_is_in_recovery=f), all 4 pre-failover rows intact, and a new write (row 5) accepted confirming writable primary with zero data loss

selected_evidence.requirement: Surviving standby re-pointed to new primary and catches up
selected_evidence.summary: node3 log shows it switched to timeline 2 and streamed from node2; pg_stat_replication on node2 shows node3 streaming; node3 query shows all 5 rows including the post-failover write

selected_evidence.requirement: Recovered former primary rejoins as standby of current primary
selected_evidence.summary: pg_rewind blocked by missing wal_log_hints, so node1 was re-cloned via pg_basebackup from node2, started as standby (pg_is_in_recovery=t), and confirmed streaming under node2's pg_stat_replication with full 5-row data set matching primary

selected_evidence.requirement: Baseline boot identity and health captured on all nodes before restart protocol
selected_evidence.summary: boot_id captured for node1 (84419b90...), node2 (717db5a2...), node3 (f54d7366...) prior to any restart

selected_evidence.requirement: node3 restart: acknowledgement, changed boot identity, recovered state

selected_evidence.requirement: node1 restart: acknowledgement, changed boot identity, recovered state

selected_evidence.requirement: node2 (primary) restart: acknowledgement, changed boot identity, recovered state, quorum/full health before completion
selected_evidence.summary: systemctl reboot acknowledged before disconnect; boot_id changed 717db5a2->ebbe42b2; postgresql-16 active, pg_is_in_recovery=f (still primary), both node1 and node3 reconnected as streaming standbys, and all 5 rows verified intact
